purpose: Tenth expanded public source layer focused on photocleavable and photoactive protecting-group probes, hypoxia-activated and redox prodrugs, CNS blood-brain-barrier route motifs, PNA/PMO/LNA/XNA oligomer backbones, BNCT and radiometal theranostic payloads, caged covalent and activity-based probes, polycyclic cage natural-product topology, and crystallization/salt/polymorph process endpoints.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate photocage, redox-prodrug, CNS/BBB, xeno-oligomer, BNCT/radiometal, activity-based-probe, cage-natural-product, or solid-form process policy

route-specific wavelength, activation mode, BBB transporter or efflux risk, backbone monomer identity, isotope/radionuclide or boron payload, probe reactivity, cage topology, counterion, cocrystal former, polymorph, and crystallization endpoint review
photochemistry, toxicology, oncology-mode, CNS safety, oligonucleotide manufacturing, radiochemical, chemical-probe, natural-product bioactivity, regulatory, or process-control review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
photochemical, hypoxia-activated, CNS-active, oligonucleotide, radiochemical, covalent-probe, cage-natural-product, and solid-form process entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Photocleavable protecting groups, photocages, and photoactive probe handles
families.strategic_principle: Separate active parent ligand, photolabile cage or chromophore, release wavelength, and biological context. Light-triggered release is route metadata, not an ordinary protecting group.

families.name: Hypoxia-activated, bioreductive, and redox-sensitive prodrug motifs
families.strategic_principle: Expose payload, trigger, reductive activation mode, and tissue or tumor context. Redox activation logic is compliance-gated route policy rather than generic linker cleavage.

families.name: CNS privileged scaffolds, BBB transporter motifs, and brain-delivery prodrug handles
families.strategic_principle: Separate CNS-active scaffold, polarity or prodrug masking, transporter engagement, and efflux risk. BBB policy changes route critique and precursor acceptance.

families.name: Peptide nucleic acids, morpholinos, locked nucleic acids, and xeno-oligomer backbones
families.strategic_principle: Separate base sequence from backbone chemistry, monomer identity, protecting group or solid-phase boundary, and conjugation handle. Xeno-oligomer backbones are strategic, not ordinary substituent changes.

families.name: Boron neutron-capture and radiometal therapeutic payload-route motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate targeting vector, boron or radionuclide payload, chelator or cluster, linker, and dosimetry or isotope policy. Payload identity is route-defining and radiochemical compliance-gated.

families.name: Caged covalent probes, photoaffinity handles, and activity-based-probe route motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate recognition fragment, reactive warhead, reporter or enrichment tag, linker, and activation mode. Probe reactivity and biological labeling context must gate route promotion.

families.name: Polycyclic cage-like natural products, bridged topologies, and rearrangement networks
families.strategic_principle: Expose cage topology, bridgehead connectivity, ring-fusion order, and rearrangement or cascade logic. Topology dominates template matching and must be route metadata.

families.name: Process salt, cocrystal, polymorph, and crystallization endpoint route control
families.strategic_principle: Separate chemical synthesis from salt/cocrystal former, polymorph risk, crystallization handle, and regulatory endpoint. Solid form is process route metadata and not equivalent to stock closure.

anchors.name: Photocaged parent ligand or probe with reviewed chromophore, release wavelength, and biological context
Hypoxia-activated or redox-sensitive prodrug with reviewed trigger, payload, and activation context
CNS-active scaffold or prodrug with BBB transporter, polarity, and efflux metadata
PNA, PMO, LNA, or XNA oligomer with reviewed sequence, backbone, monomer, and conjugation policy
BNCT boron cluster or radiometal theranostic payload with targeting-vector and isotope policy
Activity-based, covalent, or photoaffinity probe with reviewed warhead, reporter, and activation context
Polycyclic cage-like natural product with reviewed bridge topology and rearrangement logic
Process endpoint with reviewed salt, cocrystal, polymorph, or crystallization control metadata

disconnections.name: Photocaged ligand to active parent plus chromophore and release-handle policy

forward_logic: separate active ligand synthesis from cage or chromophore installation
track wavelength, release byproducts, and biological exposure context
avoid treating the photocage as an ordinary protecting group when route acceptance depends on light activation
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose the active parent and cage separately and carry wavelength/release metadata through scoring.

evidence.citation: Long-wavelength photoremovable protecting-group review discusses in vivo-oriented photocage design.
pHP and coumarin photoremovable protecting-group review provides public photocage context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit parent ligand, cage chromophore, release wavelength, and byproduct metadata

disconnections.name: Photoactive probe to parent motif plus wavelength, cell-context, and activation policy

break_bonds: photoactive handle to parent motif boundary
forward_logic: track whether the route is making a chemical probe, caged agonist, or release-controlled reagent
separate chromophore tuning from parent-motif SAR
require biological-mode metadata before accepting photoactive probe proposals
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use photoactive entries as route-policy records when wavelength and biological activation context are explicit.

evidence.citation: Caged phytohormone review links chemical inactivation to controlled physiological response.
BODIPY photocage review covers mechanisms, properties, and applications of meso-methyl BODIPY photocages.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit parent motif, chromophore tuning, and activation context

disconnections.name: Hypoxia-activated prodrug to payload plus reductive trigger and tumor-context policy

break_bonds: prodrug masking group to active payload boundary
forward_logic: separate active payload from trigger or masking chemistry
track hypoxia, theragnostic, or radiation-combination context before route promotion
treat activation selectivity as strategic metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose trigger/payload separation and carry hypoxia-activation metadata instead of generic prodrug cleavage.

evidence.citation: Hypoxia-activated prodrug review discusses cancer-therapy context.
Hypoxia-activated theragnostic prodrug review summarizes current state and perspectives.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit trigger, payload, activation mode, and tumor-context metadata

disconnections.name: Quinone or redox-sensitive motif to bioreductive trigger plus release policy

break_bonds: redox linker to carrier scaffold boundary
forward_logic: separate redox trigger installation from payload or carrier synthesis
track reduction pathway and release logic as route metadata
flag quinone and bioreductive entries for toxicology and activation review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use redox-linker records for route critique and activation-policy scoring, not automatic proposal generation.

evidence.citation: Quinone bioreductive prodrug review covers delivery-agent context.
Clinical review discusses hypoxia-activated prodrugs with radiation-therapy combinations.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit redox trigger, release pathway, and activation selectivity

disconnections.name: CNS route to active scaffold plus BBB transporter or prodrug-masking motif

break_bonds: prodrug masking group to active scaffold boundary
forward_logic: separate active CNS scaffold from BBB-enabling motif
track transporter rationale, polarity, and efflux risk before route acceptance
avoid stock-closing advanced masked CNS analogues without delivery metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that explicitly separate CNS pharmacophore from BBB delivery or masking strategy.

evidence.citation: Transporter-conscious drug-design review discusses beneficial aspects of transporter-aware design.
BBB transporter review frames endogenous transporters as therapeutic targets for small-molecule CNS discovery.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit active scaffold, masking or transporter motif, and BBB metadata

disconnections.name: CNS privileged scaffold to polarity, efflux, and brain-penetration route policy

target_features: polar surface area or ionization constraint

forward_logic: separate scaffold assembly from CNS exposure tuning
track whether substituent changes serve potency, BBB penetration, or efflux avoidance
flag CNS-active route proposals for biological-mode review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use CNS entries to critique substituent strategy and exposure policy, not to infer stock status from BBB-optimized analogues.

evidence.citation: Review covers structural modification strategies to improve blood-brain-barrier penetration.
Medicinal-chemistry review discusses strategies for drug delivery to the brain.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit exposure-tuning role and efflux or polarity metadata

disconnections.name: PNA or morpholino oligomer to base sequence plus non-natural backbone monomer policy

forward_logic: separate sequence design from backbone monomer synthesis and oligomer assembly
track PNA, PMO, LNA, or XNA identity before scoring route feasibility
avoid treating modified oligomers as ordinary peptide or nucleotide fragments
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit backbone-class and monomer-boundary metadata for xeno-oligomer targets.

evidence.citation: PNA synthesis review discusses challenges of peptide nucleic acid synthesis.
Morpholino antisense review covers phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomers as antiviral compounds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit sequence, backbone, monomer, and assembly-boundary metadata

disconnections.name: LNA/XNA or peptide-oligonucleotide conjugate to backbone class plus conjugation policy

forward_logic: separate oligomer synthesis from postsynthetic conjugation or monomer modification
track backbone class and application mode before proposal promotion
carry manufacturing, analytical, and biological-mode metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use XNA/LNA entries when backbone class and conjugation role are explicit, not as generic nucleoside analogues.

evidence.citation: Approved oligonucleotide therapeutics review discusses chemistry, structure, and function.
Xeno nucleic acid review covers advances in synthesis, diagnostics, and therapeutics.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit backbone class, conjugation site, and modality metadata

disconnections.name: BNCT agent to targeting vector plus boron cluster or boron-rich payload policy

break_bonds: boron cluster to targeting vector boundary
forward_logic: separate targeting-vector synthesis from boron payload installation
track boron content, localization rationale, and BNCT modality context
keep boron therapeutic records radiochemical and oncology-mode gated
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose boron payload, linker, and targeting-vector roles instead of generic boron substituent logic.

evidence.citation: BNCT boron-cluster review summarizes state-of-the-art boron clusters for therapy.
Boron chemistry review covers medical applications of boron chemistry.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit targeting vector, boron payload, linker, and modality metadata

disconnections.name: Radiometal theranostic to targeting vector plus chelator, linker, and isotope policy

forward_logic: separate targeting vector, linker, chelator, and radionuclide roles
track isotope compatibility and pharmacokinetic linker rationale
require radiochemical policy before proposal-source promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use radiometal records to critique linker/chelator/isotope strategy and avoid accepting unlabeled precursors as complete routes.

evidence.citation: Theranostic radiopharmaceutical review frames radionuclide, bifunctional chelator, and pharmacokinetics-modifying linker as scaffold components.
AAZTA-derived chelator review covers chelator design for theranostic radiopharmaceuticals.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit targeting vector, chelator, linker, and isotope metadata

disconnections.name: Activity-based probe to recognition element plus warhead, linker, and reporter policy

break_bonds: reporter linker to probe scaffold boundary
forward_logic: separate recognition fragment, electrophile, linker, and reporter or enrichment tag
track target class, selectivity, and labeling mode before proposal promotion
avoid generic covalent-inhibitor logic when reporter context defines the molecule
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose probe architecture and selectivity metadata instead of treating probes as ordinary covalent inhibitors.

evidence.citation: Activity-based chemical-probe review discusses selectivity aspects of probes.
Activity-based protein-profiling review provides oxidoreductase ABPP context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit recognition element, warhead, reporter, and target-class metadata

disconnections.name: Photoaffinity or caged covalent probe to parent ligand plus activation, linker, and reporter policy

forward_logic: separate recognition motif from photoactivatable or caged reactive handle
track activation wavelength, crosslinking mode, and reporter strategy
flag photoaffinity and caged-probe entries for photochemistry and biological-mode review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use caged/photoaffinity records only when activation mode and probe-readout architecture are explicit.

evidence.citation: Oligonucleotide photoaffinity-probe review covers chemical tools for protein labeling.
Photoaffinity-probe ABPP review discusses releasable-linker applications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit recognition motif, activation mode, linker, and reporter strategy

disconnections.name: Polycyclic cage natural product to bridgehead core plus ring-fusion topology policy

forward_logic: map cage topology and bridgehead connectivity before template scoring
separate scaffold construction from peripheral oxidation or SAR edits
track rearrangement or cascade logic where it defines the skeleton
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose bridge topology and cage-core formation rather than flattening the target into ordinary ring annulations.

evidence.citation: Benzobicyclo construction review discusses strategies for a bridged natural-product core.
Sarpagine-ajmaline alkaloid review provides public context for complex polycyclic alkaloid synthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit bridgehead, ring-fusion, and topology-forming step metadata

disconnections.name: Bridged or cage scaffold to rearrangement/cascade precursor plus topology-risk policy

forward_logic: separate topology-forming cascade or rearrangement from late functionalization
track strain, bridgehead, and biosynthetic analogy as advisory metadata
avoid over-crediting generic cyclizations that do not form the cage topology
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use bridged-cascade records to penalize routes that never address the topology-forming event.

evidence.citation: Aplydactone synthesis review provides marine bridged sesquiterpene natural-product context.
Dimeric naphthylisoquinoline alkaloid review covers complex bioactive natural-product topology.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit topology-forming cascade, rearrangement precursor, and strain metadata

disconnections.name: Process endpoint to neutral/API form plus counterion, cocrystal former, or solid-form policy

forward_logic: separate API synthesis from salt or cocrystal selection
track counterion, coformer, solubility, and developability rationale
avoid treating a salt or cocrystal endpoint as a chemical stock equivalent
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use solid-form entries to keep process endpoints distinct from chemical disconnection success.

risks: coformer or counterion suitability review required

evidence.citation: Solubility strategy review discusses development approaches relevant to salt and solid-form selection.
FDA guidance page provides regulatory classification context for pharmaceutical co-crystals.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit parent API, counterion or coformer, and solid-form rationale

disconnections.name: Polymorph or crystallization endpoint to chemical route plus solid-form transformation policy

break_bonds: chemical synthesis to crystallization endpoint boundary
forward_logic: separate chemical-route closure from crystallization and polymorph control
track solid-form transformation, analytical characterization, and process endpoint
require regulatory/process metadata before accepting a route as complete
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Penalize routes that close at the right connectivity but ignore polymorph, crystallization, or process endpoint requirements.

evidence.citation: Solid-form transformation risk review discusses managing drug-product solid-form risk.
ICH Q6A guideline provides public specification decision-tree context including polymorphic forms.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit polymorph, crystallization, and process-control metadata

source_notes.summary: The v11 expansion promotes the backlog families for photocage/photoactive probes, hypoxia/redox prodrugs, CNS/BBB route motifs, PNA/PMO/LNA/XNA oligomer backbones, BNCT/radiometal payloads, caged activity-based probes, polycyclic cage topology, and solid-form process endpoints.

Photochemical, hypoxia-activated, CNS-active, oligonucleotide, radiochemical, covalent-probe, bioactive cage-natural-product, and solid-form process records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit safety, biological-mode, radiochemical, regulatory, process, or manufacturing review as applicable.
